text: dsh-decision-split 是面向 DSH Web 的侧栏阅读插件：它在 agent 消息动作区提供“在侧栏查看全文”按钮，并把所选消息显示在可独立滚动的原生右侧 Tab 中。用户可以阅读完整 Markdown 内容、表格和代码块，切换消息时复用同一个 Tab，标题随消息内容变化。适合需要边参考长回复边继续操作主对话的场景；无需额外配置。

dsh-decision-split adds a “view full message” action to DSH Web replies. It opens the selected message in a scrollable sidebar tab and renders Markdown, including tables and code. Switching messages reuses the tab and updates its title. No extra setup is needed.

功能「侧栏查看全文」：为有文本的 assistant 消息提供入口按钮。点击后按消息 ID 打开对应的右侧 Tab，供用户在侧栏查看该消息。
功能「完整 Markdown 阅读」：侧栏根据选中的消息内容渲染标题、段落、列表、表格、链接和代码块，内容区域可独立滚动。
功能「切换消息并复用 Tab」：点击另一条消息的入口会用新的消息 ID 打开或聚焦同类侧栏 Tab，避免为每条消息重复创建标签。
功能「动态标签标题」：右侧 Tab 标题从当前消息的首个 Markdown 标题或首行文本生成；找不到消息时显示默认标题。

dsh-decision-split README · dsh-decision-split：**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

> A split-view reader for long AI agent responses in the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI.

`dsh-decision-split` is an open-source DSH Web UI plugin that lets you read a completed assistant message in a **native right-side tab**, without losing your place in the main conversation. The selected message has its own scrollable Markdown view, so you can reference long responses while continuing to work in DSH.

dsh-decision-split README · dsh-decision-split：- **Package:** [dsh-decision-split on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-decision-split)
- **Releases:** [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/yuanbaoerer/dsh-decision-split/releases)
- **License:** [MIT](LICENSE)

dsh-decision-split README · Features：- **Open a completed response:** Adds a “在侧栏查看全文” (“View full message in sidebar”) action to completed assistant messages containing text. The action does not appear while a response is still being generated.
- **Read full Markdown:** Displays the selected message in a separately scrollable panel, including tables, code blocks, and inline code.
- **Switch without duplicate tabs:** Selecting another message updates the existing plugin tab rather than opening a new one.
- **Use DSH's native sidebar:** On DSH 0.2.x, the plugin uses the built-in rightbar tab system, including native close/collapse controls and user-adjustable width.
- **Keep existing message actions:** Integrates with `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` alongside the host's built-in actions, such as deliverables and feedback.

dsh-decision-split README · Features：This is a **read-only message viewer**. It does not add decision forms, an embedded prompt field, or automatic decision submission; use DSH's native `ask_user_question` flow for interactive decisions.
dsh-decision-split README · Preview：*The screenshot shows the earlier DSH 0.1.x interface. Plugin v0.2.5 uses DSH 0.2.x's native rightbar tab layout instead.*

dsh-decision-split README · DSH 0.2.x (current plugin)：Install the latest published version from npm:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-decision-split
```

Restart your running `dsh web` process after installation.

Alternatively, install the v0.2.5 release archive directly:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/yuanbaoerer/dsh-decision-split/releases/download/v0.2.5/dsh-decision-split-0.2.5.tgz
```

dsh-decision-split README · DSH 0.2.x (current plugin)：> **Compatibility:** v0.2.5 was tested with DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`. Compatibility with every future DSH 0.2.x release is not guaranteed; check the [compatibility notes](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) when upgrading.

dsh-decision-split README · DSH 0.1.x (legacy)：Use plugin **v0.2.4** instead of v0.2.5:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-decision-split@0.2.4
```

Plugin v0.2.4 was tested with DSH `0.1.2-rc.1`. The newer rightbar implementation is not compatible with the old DSH 0.1.x layout.

dsh-decision-split README · Usage：1. Open your conversation in `dsh web` and wait for an assistant response to finish.
2. Click **“在侧栏查看全文”** at the end of a text response.
3. Read its full Markdown in the right-side tab. Click the action on another completed message to switch the content in the same tab.
4. Close the tab or collapse the right sidebar using DSH's own controls.

No plugin-specific configuration is required.

dsh-decision-split README · Compatibility：| DSH version | Plugin version | Verified result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` | `0.2.5` | ✅ Verified with runtime end-to-end checks (October 19, 2026) |
| `0.1.2-rc.1` | `0.2.4` | ✅ Verified (September 7, 2026) |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` | `0.2.4` | ❌ Incompatible: DSH removed the legacy details/sidebar APIs |

See [`docs/COMPATIBILITY.md`](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) for specific API changes, validation steps, and test notes.

dsh-decision-split README · Known limitations：- The sidebar action appears only for completed text-containing assistant messages with a message ID.
- In DSH 0.2.x, a tab restored after refreshing the page may not retain the previously selected message and can show an empty state.
- Sidebar width is managed by DSH, not forced by this plugin.
- Compatibility with plugins that also customize the right sidebar has not been comprehensively verified.

dsh-decision-split README · Development and contributing：The v0.2.5 implementation registers a rightbar tab via `ctx.sidebarRightTabs` and opens it through `ctx.sidebarRight.openTab`. Message actions are registered in `conversation.chat.assistant-actions`; the tab's content and title use the native sidebar slots.

For the project layout, local development workflow, and release process, see [`docs/DEVELOPMENT.md`](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md).

dsh-decision-split README · Development and contributing：Bug reports and contributions are welcome through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/yuanbaoerer/dsh-decision-split/issues). If reporting a compatibility problem, include the DSH version, plugin version, steps to reproduce, and any relevant console errors.

dsh-decision-split README · dsh-decision-split：DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的分屏阅读插件：把 agent 消息放到右侧详情栏独立滚动展示。

> **DSH 版本**：0.2.5 起适配 DSH `0.2.x`（在 `0.2.1-rc.2` 实测），内容渲染在右侧栏的原生 rightbar Tab 中；DSH `0.1.x` 请继续使用 0.2.4。

dsh-decision-split README · 功能：- **入口按钮**：每条已完成轮次的含文本 agent 消息尾部显示「在侧栏查看全文」按钮（回复生成结束后出现，进行中的轮次不显示）；
- **右侧详情栏**：以 rightbar Tab 展示该条消息的完整 markdown（表格、代码块、行内 code），独立滚动；Tab chip 标题跟随该消息首个标题；
- **切换与开合**：点击其它消息的按钮会复用同一个 Tab 并切换内容，不会重复开 Tab；收起用右侧栏自带的 Tab 关闭或「收起右侧边栏」控件；
- **与 harness 动作共存**：按钮注册在 `conversation.chat.assistant-actions`，与 harness 自带的「产物」「反馈」等消息动作并排显示，互不抢占；
- **详情栏宽度**：使用 rightbar 默认宽度（首次约 45% 视口，用户拖动后保持），插件不再固化宽度；
- **不含决策输入**：无内嵌输入框、无决策回传；决策与提问使用 harness 原生 `ask_user_question`。
dsh-decision-split README · 效果图：*消息尾部的「在侧栏查看全文」入口，以及右侧详情栏的完整内容展示（截图为 0.1.x 旧版 UI，0.2.x 使用 rightbar Tab 外观）。*

dsh-decision-split README · 安装：从 npm 安装（推荐）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-decision-split
```

或从 GitHub release 安装（资产名中的版本号跟随最新 release）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/yuanbaoerer/dsh-decision-split/releases/latest/download/dsh-decision-split-0.2.5.tgz
```

安装后重启 `dsh web` 生效。
dsh-decision-split README · 使用方式：装上即用，无需配置。已完成轮次的含文本 agent 消息尾部会出现「在侧栏查看全文」按钮，点击即在右侧栏阅读该条消息的完整内容；切换消息会复用同一个 Tab，收起用右侧栏自带的关闭/收起控件。
